notes.title: Phantom's Estate Role Update | Update V 1.1.0.0
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone!
I'm excited to bring you the first Major Update for Phantom's Estate! Version 1.1.0.0 introduces a host of bug fixes, new items, and an exciting new gameplay feature—Roles!

Introducing Roles!
Players can now select a unique role at the start of each game, each offering special abilities—but with significant drawbacks to keep things balanced. Choose wisely!

Available Roles:
🔹 Recruit (Unlimited Players)

The default role, available to everyone from the start.
Moves faster than all other roles.

🔹 Visioner (1 Player Per Game)

Gains a special UI warning 5 seconds before the ghost begins a hunt.
However, this ability comes at a cost—losing sanity faster than other players.

🔹 Tracker (1 Player Per Game)

The only role that can use the new item, the Tracker.
The Tracker updates every 5 seconds, revealing the ghost’s current location.
Be cautious! If the ghost spots this player during a hunt, its movement speed increases for all players until it switches targets.

🔹 Engineer (1 Player Per Game)

Can remotely restore power anywhere on the map by standing still and holding “X.”
However, if their sanity drops below 70%, the ghost will instantly begin a hunt!

Unlocking Roles:
Roles must be earned by correctly identifying ghosts a certain number of times:

Recruit – Unlocked by default
Visioner – 15 correct ghost identifications
Tracker – 30 correct ghost identifications
Engineer – 45 correct ghost identifications

New Item: The Tracker

This powerful new item helps locate the ghost’s current room—but use it strategically, as it can make you an even bigger target!

Bug Fixes & Improvements
✅ Fixed lights not returning to normal intensity after hunts
✅ Increased max and default mouse speed
✅ Fixed item duplication when placing motion detectors or cam recorders
✅ Lowered button sound volume
✅ Fixed a loud smash noise at the start of each game
✅ Fixed a bug where clicking the map multiple times would cause the host to get stuck in a loading loop
✅ Improved ghost hunting movement logic

This update brings a whole new layer of strategy to Phantom’s Estate! Let me know what you think, and I can’t wait to see how you use the new roles. Enjoy the hunt! 👻🔦

notes.title: v1.0.1.0 Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
Phantom's Estate has just been Updated to V1.0.1.0.

This update covers some main bugs in the game aswell as adding new things.

V1.0.1.0 Changelog
Bug Fixes:

Fixed a bug that allowed players to change the ghost board after returning to the lobby.
Removed stacked items like bowls and cups, which also eliminated the loud smash noise they caused.
Fixed misplaced handprints in the Barn map.
Resolved an issue where ghosts wouldn’t decide on their activities at the start of the game.
Fixed the Camera Recorder prefab not disappearing after being unequipped.
Fixed the Motion Detector prefab not disappearing after being unequipped.
Fixed the Motion Detector for proper functionality in multiplayer games.
New Additions & Changes:

Added a Master Volume slider in the Audio Settings for better control over game sounds.
Increased the range of player voice chat from 15m to 25m for clearer communication.

That is everything for this update but please remember to Update your game to be able to play online and to recieve these updates.

Have you come across any bugs?
Join our discord and let us know!

https://discord.gg/KhH93TgAwm

notes.title: V1.0.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hotfix V1.0.0.1

Hey everyone! I’ve just uploaded the first hotfix for Phantom's Estate, addressing several issues that have been reported. Thank you so much to everyone who has supported the game and shared their valuable feedback!

What’s Fixed:

. Battery Pickup Issue: Resolved the problem where players couldn't pick up the Battery in the "Bungalow" location.

. Network Optimization: Reduced unnecessary network calls at the start and during gameplay for smoother performance.

. Mouse Sensitivity Fix: The Mouse UI Sensitivity setting now stays saved in the settings menu after restarting the game.

. Screen Mode Fixes: The screen mode now properly retains your preferences after a restart, with dropdown values displaying correctly.

That's all for this quick hotfix. Please make sure to update your game to V1.0.0.1 so you can continue joining multiplayer sessions!

Want to stay updated and join our discord? Click the link below!
https://discord.gg/KhH93TgAwm
